name: Menubar
intent: Persistent horizontal application menu bar (File / Edit / View …) with always-visible top-level menus. Items highlight on pointer or keyboard focus using the --menu-highlight token and carry a pointer cursor.
when: A desktop-app-style command surface that stays visible
Many grouped commands organized into top-level menus

chooseOver.because: DropdownMenu is a single menu opened on demand; Menubar is a persistent strip of menus
NavigationMenu is for section/site navigation links; Menubar is for application commands

commonMistakes.mistake: Using Menubar for primary page navigation
commonMistakes.fix: Use NavigationMenu or the app sidebar
commonMistakes.avoidOverride: Use for primary page navigation — use NavigationMenu or the app sidebar

usage: Use Menubar to help users navigate through your application or content hierarchy. This component provides clear wayfinding and helps users understand their current location within the interface.

Menubar is ideal for multi-page applications, content-heavy interfaces, or any situation where users need to move between different sections. Keep navigation patterns consistent across your application for better user experience.
